context: 2026-11-17: blocked on upstream. duckdb/duckdb#28860 and #28859 both OPEN, no comments.
description:
## Problem
DuckDB 2.0.0 runs the correlated EXISTS with equality and `<>` used by TPC-DS Q16/Q94/Q95 4x slower than 1.5.6 at SF1 and 17x at SF10 (filed upstream as https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/issues/28860). BenchBox lifted its `<2.0.0` pin, so DuckDB results on these queries reflect the regression. Separately, `tpcds_answers()` raises "Don't have TPC-DS answers for SF 10" in 2.0.0 (https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/issues/28859), so SF10 answer checks cannot use DuckDB's bundled answers. Both open with no reply as of 2026-11-17.

## Trigger
Blocked until #28860 is fixed in a released DuckDB version (or closed as won't-fix). Check monthly; append the check date and state to context.

## Method on trigger
Through `make heavy-run`, time Q16/Q94/Q95 at SF1 and SF10 (SF10 on a host that can hold it) on the fixed version vs 2.0.0, best of 5 after a warm-up, alternating arms. If faster, raise BenchBox's DuckDB floor or lock only by a separate dependency PR.

## Decision gate
- Upstream fixed: re-time and record; any lock change is its own PR.
- Upstream won't-fix: ask the owner whether to note the regression in published DuckDB results; agents do not edit published results.
- #28859: if BenchBox ever relies on `tpcds_answers()` at SF10, record the alternative used; no reference-answer regeneration.

## Guardrails
Timing and memory runs only through `make heavy-run` after `make heavy-status`; never force admission, set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK, disable the watchdog, or pass `--ignore-memory-warnings` without the owner's approval in that task. Never kill processes by pattern; the host is shared. No SQL text changes to work around the regression.
